secrets: none: the server needs no credential for check_design; ask_engineer (paid API) never called

result.instructions: Independent engineering checks: Muse Spark reads, the ZTL stand proves. Call check_design before telling a person a design will work.

tools.name: brick_format
tools.description: The ZTL stand's brick format (BRICKS.md): how to write an engineering problem — quantities with tolerances or ranges, laws, requirements, optional catalogue slots and an objective — so that check_design can judge it. Read this before writing a brick.

tools.name: check_design
tools.description: Independent check of an engineering design by the ZTL stand, with no AI involved. Give a brick (JSON object, see brick_format). Answers EARNED (proved for every value the tolerances allow), REFUTED (with a concrete failing point), or OPEN (cannot vouch either way), plus what it proved (guaranteed ranges, the chosen design, an optimum). Free: runs locally.

brick.description: the problem as a ZTL stand brick

time_limit_s.description: stop after this many seconds (default 300, at most 1800)

tools.name: ask_engineer
tools.description: Ask ZTL Engineer in plain words, in any language, optionally with files (a nameplate photo, a datasheet PDF, a SPICE netlist + BOM, a truss deck). Meta's Muse Spark reads them and writes the brick; the ZTL stand judges it. Returns the verdict, the values the AI read (check them) and where the report is. Spends Meta Model API credit.

files.description: paths of local files to attach
